summary.headline: Comets and Historical Omens
summary.text: Astrological effects of comets appearing at royal and ordinary ascendants, including oppression, sedition, enemies, and calamities. The passage names seven tailed comets, discusses their motion and celestial placement, then recounts omens before the missions of Jesus and Muhammad, including Waqidi’s report of falling stars at Mecca.
